notes.title: Family Breeding is Now Fully Released on Steam! 🎉
notes.content:
Family Breeding has officially left Early Access and is now fully launched on Steam! 🚀 After months of hard work and feedback from our amazing community, the complete version of the game is finally here.

But we’re not stopping there! We’ll continue to make improvements over time, with updates and new content, plus we’re adding more languages to make the game even more accessible for players around the world. 🌍🛠️

Thanks so much for all your support – we can’t wait for you to dive into the full experience! 🙌🎮

notes.title: New content added!
notes.content:
Hey guys, more content added to Family Breeding.
In case of any bugs while loading saves, try starting a new game and picking "jump to the new update" option.

Anything else, just let me know! Hope you guys enjoy it.
